description: This script checks for proper usage of PySpark-specific error classes in Python files within a specified directory, excluding certain subdirectories. It searches for 'raise' statements and verifies if the raised error is among a predefined list of PySpark errors, reporting any mismatches.

methods.name: find_py_files
methods.description: Recursively finds all Python (.py) files in a directory, excluding specified subdirectories.

methods.name: check_errors_in_file
methods.description: Checks a given file for 'raise' statements that do not use recognized PySpark error classes.

methods.name: check_pyspark_custom_errors
methods.description: Checks multiple directories for files with improper PySpark error usage, aggregating errors.
